question: Which local or publicly obtainable products can support a genuinely fresh transfer of the frozen P0586D baryonic metric, and which products only look independent because they are already GR/NFW lens reconstructions?

classification.raw_observable: detector counts, calibrated imaging, catalog photometry/redshift, multiple-image sky positions, or per-source shear/magnification measurements
classification.baryonic_forward_input: stellar or gas mass/light product constructed without using the scored lens residual
classification.model_dependent_lens_summary: kappa, NFW mass, or dark-halo location inferred under a standard lens model
classification.spent: a lens observable already used to select or tune this formula branch
classification.fresh: a system whose lens residual was not used anywhere in P0586-P0587

independent_second_channel_gate: raw weak-shear or magnification likelihood with covariance
decision_rule: Select the fresh system with the most raw lens constraints and the largest number of independently reconstructible baryonic components. Do not score a derived kappa or NFW mass as raw evidence.
claim_limits: A catalog produced after ICL subtraction does not preserve the subtracted ICL map.
The four published MACS J0416 gas dPIE components are a Chandra-derived baryonic model, not raw X-ray counts, and the quoted table does not supply their full covariance.
The Bergamini positional errors were rescaled using the fitted standard lens model; the published 0.43 arcsec RMS is a descriptive scoring scale, not an independent covariance.
CCCP weak-lensing masses and RELICS kappa profiles are useful comparisons but are not raw alternative-metric likelihoods.
No fresh formula score is authorized by this readiness audit alone.
